test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sports was NOT played at Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shooting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games in Birmingham concluded on 8 August 2022.
 
• India finished fourth in the medals tally with 61 medals comprising 22 gold, 16 silver and 23 bronze in the event.
 
• India bagged a total of 12 medals in wrestling, the most in any sport in the 2022 Games.
 
• Australia topped the medals tally with a total of 178 medals.
 
• Except **Shooting **The other three sports, **badminton, wrestling, and cricket T20**, were all played at the 2022 Commonwealth Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Commonwealth Games often referred to as the Friendly Games, is an international multi-sport event.
 
• It involves athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930, and, with the exception of 1942 and 1946, has taken place every four years since then.
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games took place at the Alexander Stadium in Birmingham, England, from 28 July to 8 August 2022.
 
• Perry the Bull is Birmingham 2022's official mascot.
 
• Indian men's hockey team captain Manpreet Singh & shuttler PV Sindhu were India's flag-bearers for the opening ceremony of the Commonwealth Games (CWG) 2022.
